Hfss setup workflow

Create a setup with Hfss.create_setup and then configure a frequency sweep.

setup = hfss.create_setup(name="Setup1", Frequency="10GHz")
sweep = setup.create_frequency_sweep(
    unit="GHz", start_frequency=8, stop_frequency=12
)

Export solver evidence

Use export_touchstone after analyze succeeds. Preserve the project, sweep, and logs.
